notes.account: The page considers a space with exactly two strata, a closed X_0 and its complement X_1. It states Artin dévissage as data F_0, F_1 and a gluing map F_0 to i_0^*i_{1*}(F_1). It states a local-constancy criterion for constructibility, subject to accessory finiteness conditions, and says the equisingularity hypotheses give corresponding local constancy for the composite called varphi. The author then describes the category in terms of locally constant sheaves or the strata’s homotopy types, while reserving the task of specifying varphi. He suggests a schematic construction using an étale tubular neighbourhood, a topos not associated to a scheme. The final word is unfinished on this page.

notes.page_date_title_evidence: Author number 29 is centred above the first baseline. Archive pencil 174 is at bottom left. No date, title, salutation, closing or signature occurs on this continuation sheet.
notes.math_triggered_reading_decisions: The gluing-map argument made the levels of the pullback/pushforward stars consequential. Both tiny inserted definitions and the repeated composite were cropped. Source/target consistency supports the preferred pushforward reading but was not used to erase the later i/prime or star/comma ink doubts. The two occurrences of phi and the ambient X were compared directly with the half-images.
notes.proof_scope: No proof of the dévissage assertion, constructibility criterion, equisingularity assertion or tubular-neighbourhood construction was attempted. Only the narrow source/target check in check_events was performed.
notes.marks_and_layout: The literal point after il is clearly present; its intended grammatical role is not asserted. No independent separator stroke or drawing was found. Long descender strokes, including the g in à g., were not made underlines. The old L15 phrase has a separate underline. The possible terminal cancelled d remains especially uncertain because of overlap with the live types descender.
notes.page_final_hyphen: The physical final baseline ends para-. The continuation hyphen is recorded in a TeX comment and omitted from running output to permit joining the continued word, following the brief. No completion from another page was supplied.
notes.H_editorial_note: H’s note was treated only as an editorial claim. In particular, its appeal to an English version did not determine the insertion order; the curved attachment and physical levels on this page did.
